#print hadwiger_covering_conjecture
example (n : ℕ) (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ) :

  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
